declarations.name: Theorem K1. Exact coefficient spaces, including the boundary
declarations.scope: For all admissible nonidentity polynomial passports with k>=1 factors of index>=2, s>=1 literal transpositions, p total nontrivial cycles in those k factors, and s>=p-k: the complete root-marked monic coefficient locus is a nonempty algebraic open in the exact CRT chart f=Phi+QR if N>=M=I+p, or in the full moment incidence F(u)v=e if N<M. With h=M-N-1=p-s-2, rows F_bi=sum residues of z^b/Q over color i, b0..h, give every degree/monicity constraint, including all feasible deficient ranks. Critical quotient/value norm give necessary and sufficient exact exclusions. Existence uses corrected primary count/Riemann existence.

declarations.name: Theorem K2. One component and unirationality in the stable range
declarations.scope: Every such passport with s>=max(1,p-k) has exactly one absolute and one literal full-braid orbit. The affine-quotient polynomial Hurwitz space is unirational overQ of dimension k+s-2. Beyond the former p-2 threshold, K5-K6 bound every feasible deficient-rank stratum below the pure Hurwitz dimension, so each component meets one irreducible full-rank affine bundle. Finite label quotients and the full-twist argument give the asserted orbit conventions. No quotient-field rationality is claimed.

declarations.name: Theorem K3. Actual groups, all blocks, deck groups and sizes
declarations.scope: For k>=2 in this range, every tuple generates actual S_N, has only block counts1,N and deck1. For k=1, D=gcd of its full partition (including fixed points), n=N/D>=2, actual group S_n wr C_D, block counts divisors(D) union{N}, deck2 exactly n2 otherwise1. The unique full component has literal size W*N^(r-1)*product((c_i-1)!/product m_i,a!) and absolute size F*deck/N, with W the number of distinct factor-type placements.

declarations.name: Proposition K4. The first excluded level already splits
declarations.scope: The degree6 passport DT,DT,T has p4,k2,s1=p-k-1 and exactly two components, literal216/27, absolute36/9, actual groups S6 and S2 wr D3 of orders720/48, deck1/2. Signed disjoint orbit closures exhaust independent ordinary hook total243. Thus the p-k sufficient threshold cannot be lowered uniformly; no classification below it is inferred.

declarations.name: Lemma K5. Moment derivatives and the polynomial product bound
declarations.scope: For h>=1, g=Phi_w with Fw in C*e has deg<=N and B_g=g'/Z of degree<=s. For any beta of degree<=h the exact moving-critical-point derivative is beta(dF)w=-sum_j beta(u_j)B_g(u_j)*du_j/P'(u_j). At admissible monic points this is a Vandermonde Jacobian of row rank h+1. Polynomial product subspaces satisfy dim span(UV)>=dimU+dimV-1, proved by distinct leading degrees.

declarations.name: Theorem K6. Rank loss cannot create another component
declarations.scope: For h>=1 and k>=h+2, every feasible rank-r incidence stratum with deficiency delta=h+1-r has dimension<=p-delta+1, while the admissible locus is smooth pure dimension D=p+k-h-1>=p+1. Proof: left-kernel polynomials beta have degree<=h-1, derivative space V has dimension k-r; products beta*B_g have degree<=p-3, inject into p-point evaluations and supply conormal rank>=delta+k-r-1. No component can live at deficient rank. The nonempty full-rank affine-bundle open is rational and irreducible and meets every component, proving the whole good root-marked coefficient space rational/irreducible.
